checks.description: Full integration suite against the merged workspace: contract adoption, client/service roundtrip, dataset integrity.
Both implementations speak the final (injected) contract version.

hypothesis: Independent coding agents can avoid costly interface drift across runtimes.

injections.description: Product decision, delivered through the coordination channel only: the items contract moves from offset pagination (v1) to cursor pagination (v2). No role is told directly; each role's next sync is its chance to notice.

knownLimitations: The fixture is a small synthetic codebase (one endpoint, a seven-item dataset); results do not generalize to production codebases without larger fixtures.
Roles run sequentially in this harness version; genuinely parallel sessions are future work.
The mid-run change is a single clean contract revision; real interface drift is usually partial and messier.
objective: Measure whether independent coding agents in separate workspaces avoid interface drift when a contract changes mid-build, and what the coordination condition (shared files, shared git repository, Moonbooth booth) changes about integration pass rate, missed changes, rework, interventions, and cost.

roles.brief: You own src/backend. Implement the items service in src/backend/itemsService.mjs so it speaks the contract in contract/api.json exactly: export createItemsService() and a SERVICE_SHAPE constant naming the contract shape you implemented. The shared contract lives under contract/ and may change during the build; re-read it before you finish.
roles.title: Backend agent

roles.brief: You own src/frontend. Implement the items client in src/frontend/itemsClient.mjs so it speaks the contract in contract/api.json exactly: export fetchAllItems(service, pageSize) and a CLIENT_SHAPE constant naming the contract shape you implemented. The shared contract lives under contract/ and may change during the build; re-read it before you write the client.
roles.title: Frontend agent

roles.brief: You own qa. After the implementations land, write qa/report.md summarizing whether the client and the service agree with the current contract in contract/api.json.
roles.title: QA agent

stopRule: Stop a run at its wall-time cap. Stop the campaign and report if the same check fails identically across all conditions for a variant, which indicates a fixture defect rather than a condition effect.

variants.description: Every role syncs before working; the frontend adopts the injected v2 contract and the backend revisits and adopts it too. Expected: full pass, no missed changes.

steps.brief: The contract changed mid-build (see contract/api.json). Update the service to the current contract.
